description: Driving simulator dataset on human driven vehicles' gap acceptance behaviour in mixed traffic with automated vehicles provides driving-simulator observations of human gap acceptance in mixed automated and human traffic. The provider is Research creators via 4TU.ResearchData. Geographical and temporal coverage: The study collected data at TU Delft in 2020 and deposited the material in 2025. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the DataCite record of its DOI on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
